new_articles.title: Nexon Geochem validates Indian-origin raw materials for NdFeB permanent magnets
new_articles.summary: Nexon 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Nexon Geochem validates Indian-origin raw materials for NdFeB permanent magnets'이다. The company has technically validated the pathway to integrate domestic materials into its magnet manufacturing process, marking progress towards pilot production. This establishes the foundation for Nexon to build an integrated Indian supply chain for high-performance permanent magnets, from domestic feedstock to finished Nd-Fe-B magnets ” Nexon targets pilot production and customer validation Nexon plans to mobilise its offshore pilot for customer validation in India, work with customers on application-specific requirements, optimise the manufacturing process and product grades, and simultaneously advance the infrastructure, equipment and execution required for commercial-scale production The technical validation marks an important step in the technology transfer agreement between Nexon and Giredmet, as the programme progresses towards its next stage Evaluation covered raw materials and magnet performance As part of the programme, Nexon supplied Indian-origin Nd-Pr oxide, iron and ferroboron to Giredmet for technical evaluation In July 2026, Nexon Geochem signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Giredmet to jointly develop deep-processing technologies for rare-earth metal raw materials and NdFeB rare-earth permanent magnets. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: Hyundai goes big on India with 26 new models as it plots 100+ vehicle global offensive
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Hyundai goes big on India with 26 new models as it plots 100+ vehicle global offensive'이다. Hyundai is gearing up for an extensive expansion, aiming for over one hundred global vehicle launches and enhancements by 2030. In India, the automaker plans to unveil twenty-six new models along with an increase in production capacity. By diversifying its hybrid and extended-range electric vehicle lineup, Hyundai seeks to position India as its second-largest global hub, responding to a dynamic market landscape. Live Events 26 products put India on Hyundai’s global map Hyundai's 26-product India pipeline builds on a roadmap announced by Hyundai Motor India last year, when it outlined plans to invest ₹45,000 crore through FY2030 Hyundai expects electrified vehicles to account for 60% of global sales by 2030, up from 23% in 2025 The strategy is particularly aggressive in North America, where Hyundai plans to offer more than 10 hybrid models by 2030 and expects hybrids to make up about half of its regional sales India gets more manufacturing capacity To support its expanded product portfolio, Hyundai plans to increase global production capacity by 1 Hyundai plans to expand the centre tenfold by the end of this year and accumulate more than 10,000 hours of robot-learning data. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: 현대자동차는 2030년까지 자동차 판매량을 550만 대로 목표 설정했습니다.
new_articles.summary: Hyundai Motor 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 '현대자동차는 2030년까지 자동차 판매량을 550만 대로 목표 설정했습니다.'이다. 현대자동차는 전기차, 제조업, 인공지능 등 다양한 분야에 걸친 성장 계획을 발표하며 2030년까지 영업이익률을 9% 이상으로 끌어올리는 것을 목표로 하고 있다. 현대자동차는 전기차, 제조업, 인공지능 분야에 걸친 성장 계획을 발표하며 2030년까지 전 세계 차량 판매 목표를 5백만 대로 설정했다고 수요일 밝혔다. 회사는 미국 내 생산량을 늘릴 계획이며, 여기에는 현대자동차 앨라배마 공장에서 산타페 장거리 전기차(EREV)를 생산하는 것도 포함된다. 현대자동차는 계열사인 기아와 함께 세계 3위 자동차 제조업체이다. 현대자동차 주가는 0% 하락했다. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

matched_articles.title: Samsung, SK Hynix stand to benefit as Nvidia AI server costs surge
matched_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'Samsung, SK Hynix stand to benefit as Nvidia AI server costs surge'이다. Server manufacturers notified major data center customers, including Microsoft, Google, and Oracle, that prices for Nvidia-based AI systems would rise by more than 15% in many cases for shipments starting in early 2027. The price adjustments affected systems built on Nvidia's next-generation Vera Rubin and current Grace Blackwell platforms, with the exact scale of the increase varying by chip generation and memory configuration. Listen to this article in summarized format Reuters Samsung Electronics and SK hynix gained further "bargaining power" in the artificial intelligence supply chain as rising memory costs fed into prices for Nvidia-based server systems, according to a news report by Korea Herald Citing data from Counterpoint Research, the report placed SK hynix at 58% of global HBM revenue in the first quarter SK hynix established an early lead in HBM tied directly to AI accelerators, whereas Samsung maintained a larger footprint in conventional DRAM while expanding its share in advanced HBM products Counterpoint reported that the bulk of first-quarter HBM revenue stemmed from HBM3E, with HBM4 shipments expected to become more meaningful in the second half of the year As per the report, South Korean investment bank and financial services company, Hana Securities noted that the reported price increases for Nvidia-based servers put renewed attention on memory suppliers, identifying Samsung and SK hynix as prime beneficiaries amid sustained infrastructure spending projected through 2027. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
